newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Capital buys Seeff for 59.3 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Capital buys Seeff for 59.3 mln rand.

text.p: Capital Alliance Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had acquired Seeff Holdings Ltd for 59.3 million rand with effect from October 1, 1996.

Capital said it would issue to Seeff renounceable letters of allocation (RLA) in respect of some 4.091 million Capital shares at an issue price of 14.50 rand per Capital share -- the ruling price at the time of the conclusion of the deal.

Seeff undertook to renounce Capital RLA's in respect of some 2.046 million Capital shares in favour of Saflife Ltd, Capital's holding company, in exchange for renounceable letters of allocation in respect of 1.607 million Saflife shares on the basis of exchange of 14 Capital shares for 11 Saflife shares.
The effect of the transaction is that Seeff shareholders would receive 4.1380 Capital shares and 3.2513 Saflife shares for every 100 Seeff shares held.
Capital and Saflife shares would be distributed to Seeff shareholders and the listing of Seeff would be terminated, Capital said.
The transaction was dependent on certain conditions precedent being fullfilled, Capital said.
